claim_boundary: K562 remains supplementary temporal evidence under A0/A1/B tiering. The Replogle dataset provides large-n confirmation that the bridge correlation persists above null at scale; it is a single-context dataset and is not used for A0/A1/B architecture-form tiering.
figure_title: K562 temporal evidence and large-scale bridge confirmation
